subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider in UI, setup, and docs?
rationale: Source confirms current copy is still `Google Vertex AI`, but the issue wording and current Google docs differ, and provider/config ids must not be renamed casually.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update visible labels/docs to the Google-docs-aligned wording while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable technical id.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Adopt the reporter's shorter requested label even though it was not the exact wording found in the checked official Google page.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave current OpenClaw copy unchanged until Google and OpenClaw provider docs settle on a shorter stable name.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update visible labels/docs to the Google-docs-aligned wording while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable technical id.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion specifically routes UI/UX and docs labeling to @BunsDev, and that is the unresolved product-copy decision blocking implementation.
